entities.name: Pakubuwono II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pakubuwono II (1711–1749) was the last ruler of Mataram Sultanate and the first Sunan of the Surakarta Sunanate which was established after the collapse of the former Sultanate due to the Third Javanese War of Succession
